h1: Hen Party & Girls' Trip Spa Day in Uluwatu: The Glow-Up Guide
title_tag: Hen Party & Girls' Trip Spa Day in Uluwatu, Bali
meta: Planning a hen party, bachelorette or girls' trip in Bali? How to organise a group facial session in Uluwatu, what to book, and timing tips for glowing photos.
intro: Uluwatu has become one of Bali's favourite spots for hen parties, bachelorettes and girls' trips: cliff-top beach clubs, sunset dinners and villas with ocean views. Add a group facial session and everyone looks glowing in the photos. Here is how to plan it.
body_html:
Why a group facial (and not only a massage)

  • Instant glow for photos: a Korean Hydrafacial leaves skin hydrated and luminous the same day.
  • No downtime: you can go straight to dinner or the beach club.
  • Everyone gets what they need: acne-prone, sensitive or sun-tired skin, each treatment is adapted after a skin analysis.
  • A shared moment before the big nights out.

How to organise it

  1. Choose your studio: Point Face Ungasan or Point Face Bingin, both in Uluwatu. Each studio welcomes up to 3 guests at the same time, so groups of up to 6 can split between the two.
  2. Book in rotation: 3 guests are treated at the same time in each studio; bigger groups book in rotation while the others relax and shop our K-beauty corner.
  3. Message us on WhatsApp with the date, number of guests and preferred time: we plan the schedule for you.
  4. Book 1–2 weeks ahead in high season.

What to book for your group

  • Vitamin C Sunshine Glow (60 min, IDR 1,150K) — radiance before photos
  • Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift (80 min, IDR 1,300K) — the glass skin facial for the bride
  • Hydrating Ritual – Rose & Aloe (45 min, IDR 790K) — a gentle Balinese option
  • Buccal Massage (15 min, IDR 250K) — jawline definition, perfect as an add-on
  • Collagen Eye Ritual — de-puff after a late night, at no extra time

At Bingin, add a body treatment (back, chest or glutes) before a backless dress or a bikini day.

Perfect timing

  • Day 1 or 2 of the trip: facials to rehydrate skin after the flight
  • The day before the main event: glow facial + Buccal Massage
  • Avoid: a facial right before hours in the sun. Book late morning, then lunch in the shade.

Plan your group booking on WhatsApp →

Our two studios in Uluwatu

  • Point Face Ungasan — Jl. Toya Ning II No. 99, Ungasan, Kuta Selatan · WhatsApp +62 813 3793 880
  • Point Face Bingin — Jl. Pantai Cemongkak No. 9, Bingin Downtown Avenue, Pecatu · WhatsApp +62 823 3907 8379

Both open Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00, Sun 12:00–19:00. All prices include 15% tax and service charge.
